The Generative & Agentic AI Study Bible

A comprehensive, depth-first exploration of modern AI reasoning, cognitive architectures, and autonomous agent systems. Built for the 2026 engineer.

I. Core Reasoning

II. Agentic Patterns

III. LangGraph Systems

IV. Multi-Agent Swarms

Network topologies, communication protocols, and specialized persona orchestration.

V. Deep Research

Long-horizon reasoning (O1-style), sandboxed execution, and memory tiers.

VI. Agent Ops

Evaluation frameworks, security red-teaming, and production optimization.
